meta.scope: Colombia batch 2 — Short-term industrial indicators (IPI, EMMET, EAM), external sector (BOP), and deeper Banco de la República policy layer (IPoM, intervention rate, reserves).

candidates.title: Índice de Producción Industrial (IPI) — sector detail
candidates.description: Monthly volume index of industrial production covering manufacturing, mining & quarrying, electricity & gas, and water. Published with sector contributions and year-to-date rates.
candidates.notes: Core short-term industrial indicator. February 2026: 0.0% year-on-year overall; manufacturing +1.4%, electricity & gas +1.8%, water +2.2%. Built from EMMET and administrative registers.

candidates.title: Encuesta Mensual Manufacturera con Enfoque Territorial (EMMET)
candidates.description: Monthly sample survey of manufacturing establishments measuring production, sales, employment, wages and hours. Source for the manufacturing component of the IPI and for territorial industrial indicators.
candidates.notes: Primary high-frequency manufacturing survey. Covers 39 CIIU domains and selected departments/metropolitan areas. Direct input into monthly IPI and quarterly national accounts.

candidates.title: Encuesta Anual Manufacturera (EAM)
candidates.description: Annual structural survey of manufacturing establishments providing production, intermediate consumption, value added, employment and energy use. Structural counterpart to the monthly EMMET.
candidates.notes: Structural manufacturing baseline. 2024 provisional: ~6,583 establishments, production ~COP 444 trillion, value added ~COP 148 trillion. Used for national-accounts benchmarking and industrial structure analysis.

candidates.title: Balanza de Pagos y Posición de Inversión Internacional
candidates.description: Quarterly balance of payments and international investment position. Covers current account, capital/financial account, and the stock of external assets and liabilities.
candidates.notes: Core external-accounts product. Q4 2025: current-account deficit USD 3.9 bn (3.1% of quarterly GDP). Full-year 2025 deficit ~USD 10.9 bn (2.4% of GDP). Net IIP negative ~USD 200 bn.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade
candidates.description: Monthly and annual statistics of exports and imports of goods, by product, partner and customs regime. Primary real-side input into the goods account of the balance of payments.
candidates.notes: Trade data feed both the BOP and the national accounts. Mining-energy exports remain a large share; recent years have seen widening goods deficits driven by stronger import growth.

candidates.title: Informe de Política Monetaria (Banrep)
candidates.description: Periodic Monetary Policy Report of the central bank. Explains the inflation outlook, the policy framework and the implications for the intervention interest rate.
candidates.notes: Flagship policy communication product. Complements the post-meeting statements and minutes of the Junta Directiva. Central reference for the 3% inflation target and the path of the policy rate.

candidates.title: Tasa de interés de intervención / Policy interest rate
candidates.description: Main monetary-policy instrument of the Junta Directiva. The rate at which the central bank intervenes in the money market to manage liquidity and steer inflation toward the 3% target.
candidates.notes: Operational policy rate. Recent levels in the low-to-mid teens after the post-2022 tightening cycle; path is the primary signal of the monetary stance.

candidates.title: Reservas Internacionales del Banco de la República
candidates.description: Stock of international reserves managed by the central bank under constitutional and legal mandate. Published at high frequency and analysed in the BOP and Board reports to Congress.
candidates.notes: Key external-buffer indicator. End-2025 net reserves ~USD 66.4 bn (up ~USD 3.9 bn year-on-year). Adequacy metrics (IMF-style) regularly reported.

candidates.title: Marco de metas de inflación (3%) — Banco de la República
candidates.description: Operational monetary-policy framework: inflation targeting centred on 3% annual CPI inflation. Derived from the constitutional and legal mandate of the central bank.
referenced_by: Every IPoM and monetary-policy decision statement
IPC and inflation analysis that refers to the target
candidates.notes: Core policy-framework node. Continuously cited as the reference against which inflation outcomes and policy actions are evaluated.

candidates.title: Informe de la Junta Directiva al Congreso de la República
candidates.description: Statutory twice-yearly report of the central-bank Board to Congress covering economic conditions, policy decisions, reserves, the Bank’s financial situation and outlook.
candidates.notes: Accountability product required by law. March and July editions are the main formal channel from the Junta Directiva to the legislature.

proposed_edges.basis: EMMET is the primary survey source for the manufacturing component of the IPI.
The annual structural survey benchmarks and deepens the monthly manufacturing indicators.
Balance of payments and IIP are compiled by the Banco de la República.
Merchandise trade flows are a primary input into the goods account of the balance of payments.
The Monetary Policy Report analyses outcomes against the 3% inflation target.
The intervention rate is the primary instrument used to steer inflation toward the target.
Changes in reserve assets appear in the balance of payments financial account.
Statutory report of the central-bank Board to Congress.
